name: Sei Monmusu Festival!! ~Omatsuri da yo Zen'in Shuugou!~
original_name: 聖もんむすFestival!!～お祭りだよ全員集合！～
source:
This is the fandisk for the Monmusu series. All the characters from the past five games make appearances here, along with new heroines tapir Letes, dryad Prunus and baphomet Methi.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/02/01/february-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是Monmusu系列的同人盘。过去五场比赛中的所有角色都在这里亮相，还有新的女主角貘莱特斯、树妖普鲁努斯和巴菲特梅蒂。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/02/01/february-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
